Method of Attack: Operating a large-scale digital advertising fraud scheme by setting up a fake ad network
Using rented servers configured as webservers to display fake advertisements
Programming bots to simulate human internet users viewing and interacting with ads
Generating false traffic and fake ad impressions on spoofed websites

Bypassing captchas, simulating mouse movements, clicks, video interactions, and social media sign-ins
Impacted Systems: Spoofed websites including The New York Times and New York Post

Indicators of Compromise: Fake ad impressions generated between September 2014 and December 2016
